info.name: ParkWise Eval-2 API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive, evaluation-ready Postman collection for the ParkWise Smart Parking System. Includes safe runnable read-only requests, dynamic environment token capture, RBAC security assertions (401/403), and clearly labelled manual data-changing requests.

item.name: 01 - System Health & Readiness (Safe)
item.description: Public, non-mutating system diagnostics and database readiness probes.

request.description: Returns basic service uptime and server status.

exec: pm.test("No secrets or stack traces leaked", function () {

request.description: Verifies active MongoDB Atlas cluster connectivity.

exec: pm.test("Database cluster is connected and ready", function () {

item.name: 03 - Authentication & RBAC Checks
item.description: Login endpoints with dynamic token capture, and security checks demonstrating 401 Unauthorized and 403 Forbidden.

request.description: Logs in as standard driver and stores JWT into environment variable userToken.
Logs in as administrator and stores JWT into environment variable adminToken.
Demonstrates verified access to protected profile endpoint with Bearer token.

exec: pm.test("Returns user profile without passwordHash", function () {

request.description: Security assertion: Protected route called without Bearer token must return 401 Unauthorized.

exec: pm.test("Response contains standardized error message", function () {

item.name: GET Admin Summary as Normal User (Demonstrates 403)

request.description: Security assertion: Admin route called with standard user token must return 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 04 - User Bookings & Vehicles (Safe Read-Only)
item.description: Authenticated, read-only queries for personal saved vehicles and booking history.

request.description: Returns authenticated user booking history with pagination, serverTime, and all-time counts.

exec: pm.test("Contains counts breakdown and bookings array", function () {

request.description: Returns authenticated user saved vehicle profile list.

item.name: 05 - Admin Management (Safe Read-Only)
item.description: Administrative read-only queries for system summary, multi-location listings, and booking audits.

request.description: Returns operational telemetry: total/active/draft locations, slot availability counts, and booking counts.
Returns all managed facilities including drafts and archives with slot breakdown counts.
Returns system-wide booking audit list with populated user contact details (without passwordHash).

exec: pm.test("Booking audit data includes populated safe user fields", function () {

exec: pm.test("Admin slots list response is valid", function () {

item.name: 06 - Data Mutation Endpoints (Manual Only - Changes Data)
item.description: Side-effecting create, update, and delete endpoints. These modify database records and are intended for manual evaluator demonstrations, NOT unattended automated runs.

item.name: [Manual Only — Changes Data] POST User Registration

request.description: Manual data-changing request. Registers a test user account using a dynamic timestamped email to guarantee uniqueness. Must be run individually, not in Collection Runner.

exec: pm.test("Registration returns user object and auth token", function () {

item.name: [Manual Only — Changes Data] POST Create Saved Vehicle

request.description: Manual data-changing request. Creates a saved vehicle for the authenticated user with a unique registration number. Run individually. Captures vehicleId.

exec: pm.test("Vehicle created successfully and vehicleId captured", function () {

item.name: [Manual Only — Changes Data] PATCH Update Saved Vehicle

request.description: Manual data-changing request. Updates the label/type of {{vehicleId}}. Run individually.

item.name: [Manual Only — Changes Data] DELETE Saved Vehicle

request.description: Manual data-changing request. Deletes {{vehicleId}} for the authenticated user. Run individually.

item.name: [Manual Only — Changes Data] POST Create Booking

request.description: Manual data-changing request. Books a slot with dynamic requestId (UUID) and vehicleNumber. Run individually. Captures bookingId.

exec: pm.test("Booking confirmed and bookingId captured", function () {

item.name: [Manual Only — Changes Data] PATCH Cancel Booking

request.description: Manual data-changing request. Cancels the booking referenced by {{bookingId}} and releases the slot. Run individually.

item.name: [Manual Only — Changes Data] POST Admin Create Location (Lifecycle Step 1)

request.description: Lifecycle Step 1 (Admin): Creates a new facility in 'draft' status. Unsupported fields (coordinates object, zones, basePricePerHourPaise) omitted. Stores locationId for slot creation.

exec: pm.test("Draft location created with valid id", function () {

item.name: [Manual Only — Changes Data] POST Admin Create Slot (Lifecycle Step 2)

request.description: Lifecycle Step 2 (Admin): Creates a parking slot for {{locationId}}. Required before publishing because draft locations require >= 1 enabled slot to become active. Captures slotId.

exec: pm.test("Slot created successfully and slotId captured", function () {

item.name: [Manual Only — Changes Data] PATCH Admin Publish Location (Lifecycle Step 3)

request.description: Lifecycle Step 3 (Admin): Publishes the location to 'active' status. Valid because Step 2 added at least one enabled slot. Run individually.

exec: pm.test("Location successfully published to active status", function () {

item.name: [Manual Only — Changes Data] PATCH Admin Update Slot Maintenance (Lifecycle Step 4)

request.description: Lifecycle Step 4 (Admin Optional): Sets slot serviceStatus to 'maintenance'. Run individually.

exec: pm.test("Slot status updated to maintenance", function () {
